defect: The specialized config initially represented the same identified-unlinked primary actor both in ActorAttribution and in ContextActors with an utterer role.
detection: verify_actor_closure failed before config emission and before product construction with 'closed non-utterer roles required'.
cause: The specialization copied full adjudication contextActors objects even though the generic builder already emits an identified-unlinked primary ActorAttribution from actorStatus.
correction: Keep the primary identified-unlinked actor solely in ActorAttribution; reserve ContextActors for additional contextual people with non-utterer roles.

prevention.existingGenericGuard: verify_actor_closure already rejects ContextActors utterer duplication before product writes.
prevention.specializationRule: When actorStatus is identified-unlinked-master, role metadata must not repeat actorLabel in ContextActors.
